name: Auton Valley Berry Farm
tagline: Link to Auton Valley Berry Farm Facebook Page at https://www.facebook.com/Auton
description: Auton Valley Berry Farm grows Blueberries, Blackberries, and Grapes in Taylorsville, NC. The farm is independent, and its seasons run through summer and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
